action.description: Action taken by the phone in response.

gesture.description: Fixed v1 gesture dictionary. A timed gesture only switches or closes.

timeline_position_ms.description: Position on the preset timeline when the gesture landed — the 'gesture by timing'.

to_preset_id.description: Target preset for switch_next/switch_prev. Omitted for close.

dwell_duration_ms.description: In-playback head stability duration in ms. The wire contract only requires a positive value; the billable attention floor (1200 ms) is a billing-policy parameter (xr-adtech-profile section 5, decision-intelligence-core), not part of this schema, so sub-floor impressions can still be recorded for funnel analytics.

head_stable.description: True when the stability criterion held for the whole dwell window.

timeline_coverage_pct.description: Share of the preset timeline that played while the head stayed stable.

completed.description: True when the full timeline played (watched_duration_ms >= planned duration and reason = timeline_end).

reason.description: Why the preset stopped. Mirrors preset_stop reasons in XR Session Protocol v1.

watched_duration_ms.description: How long the preset actually played.

trigger.description: Why this preset started: schedule = timeline/slot, head_dwell = pre-spawn dwell on an external anchor (billboard/storefront), phone_decision = decision-core choice, predictive_prepush = pre-warmed candidate promoted to play.

event_id.description: Unique event id. Maps to idempotency_key in decision-intelligence-core (I6): redelivery is a no-op.

evidence_refs.description: REQUIRED non-empty (I3 evidence boundary). Opaque pointers to on-device proofs, e.g. 'dwell:preset_retail_spring_01:8200ms', 'gesture:palm_hold:timeline+12300ms', 'trigger:head_dwell:billboard_7'. Core treats refs as opaque; resolution happens in the evidence registry.

occurred_at_phone_ms.description: Authoritative timestamp on the phone clock (phone is the time authority, XR Session Protocol v1 §2).

preset_id.description: Preset from the phone-side library this event belongs to.

description: Domain events emitted by the phone (edge node) for the XR advertising domain profile of decision-intelligence-core. Closes the three-part v2 architecture: timed preset manifests (what to play) + XR Session Protocol v1 (how phone and glasses talk) + this schema (what gets billed and audited). Mapping to core invariants: event_id feeds idempotency_key (I6 — duplicate delivery of the same event is safe); evidence_refs MUST be non-empty (I3 — core rejects any metric without evidence, i.e. no billing without an attention/interaction proof); occurred_at_phone_ms is the authoritative metric timestamp (phone owns the clock). Transport of these events to core (e.g. POST /v1/metrics) is outside XR Session Protocol v1, which covers phone↔glasses only.
title: XR Event Schema v1 — phone → decision-intelligence-core domain events
